'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[War in Donbas (2014–2022)|War in Donbas]], [[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[Ukraine]] warns of "combat preparedness" of [[Russian separatist forces in Donbas|separatist forces]] in [[eastern Ukraine]] as the [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian military]] presence on [[Russia–Ukraine border|the border]] increases, warning of a potential new conflict. The separatists began mobilization of reservists yesterday. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-controlled-forces-donbass-raise-combat-readiness-ukraine-2021-11-23/ (Reuters)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Artifact (archaeology)|Artefacts]] from the [[Battle of Magdala]]  taken in 1868 are returned to [[Ethiopia]] by the [[United Kingdom]]. [https://www.wionews.com/videos/13-stolen-ethiopian-artefacts-returned-from-britain-after-150-years-431434 (''WION'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2018–2021 Turkish currency and debt crisis]]
**The [[Turkish lira]] falls to an all-time low of 13.44 to the [[United States dollar|U.S. dollar]]. The crash was primarily caused by [[President of Turkey|president]] [[Recep Tayyip Erdoğan]]'s defense of the [[Central Bank of the Republic of Turkey|Central Bank]]'s continued interest rate cuts amid soaring [[inflation]]. [https://www.cnbc.com/2021/11/23/turkish-lira-plummets-to-historic-low-after-erdogan-sparks-selloff-.html (CNBC)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2021 Bulgaria bus crash]]
**Forty-six people are killed and seven more are injured when a bus carrying [[North Macedonia|Macedonian]] [[tourism in Turkey|tourists]] returning from [[Istanbul]] crashes and catches fire near [[Bosnek]], [[Pernik Province]], [[Bulgaria]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2021/11/23/world/europe/bulgaria-bus-crash-north-macedonia.html (''The New York Times'')]
*Two people are killed and 16 others are injured by an [[explosion]] at an [[EDePro]] [[rocket]] engine plant near [[Belgrade]], [[Serbia]]. [https://7news.com.au/news/disaster-and-emergency/serbia-munitions-factory-blast-kills-two-c-4676765 (7 News)]
*Six people are dead and ten others are missing after the [[ferry]] they were travelling on [[Capsizing|capsizes]] in [[Kinniya]], [[Sri Lanka]]. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2021-11-23/sri-lanka-ferry-capsize-kills-six/100645318 (ABC News Australia)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Waukesha Christmas parade attack]]
**An eight-year-old boy, injured during the attack in [[Waukesha, Wisconsin]], dies, bringing the death toll to six. Several of the sixty-two injured still remain in critical condition. [https://edition.cnn.com/2021/11/23/us/waukesha-car-parade-crowd-tuesday/index.html (CNN)]
**The suspect, 39-year-old Darrell Brooks, has been charged with six counts of [[first-degree intentional homicide]], and the [[bail]] set at $5 million. [https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20211124-wisconsin-parade-ramming-claims-sixth-victim-as-eight-year-old-dies (France 24)]
*[[Colombian peace process]]
**[[Secretary-General of the United Nations|United Nations Secretary-General]] [[António Guterres]] arrives in Colombia to commemorate the fifth year of the signing of the peace deal between the [[government of Colombia]] and the [[Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia]]. [https://en.mercopress.com/2021/11/23/un-secretary-general-arrives-in-colombia-for-5th-anniversary-of-peace-deal-with-farc (MercoPress)]
**The [[Biden administration]] announces the delisting of the former [[Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia|FARC]] rebel group from the [[United States Department of State list of Foreign Terrorist Organizations]] where it had been listed since 1997. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/us-set-remove-colombia-rebel-group-farc-terrorism-list-sources-2021-11-23/ (Reuters)]
*''[[Sines v. Kessler]]''
**A U.S. federal jury finds the organizers of 2017's [[Unite the Right rally]], which includes [[White supremacy|white supremacists]] [[Richard B. Spencer]], [[Jason Kessler]], and [[Christopher Cantwell]], liable for the violence that occurred and are ordered to pay [[United States dollar|US$]]26 million to nine individuals that suffered "physical and emotional damages". However, the jury was deadlocked on whether to convict on two [[Conspiracy (criminal)|federal conspiracy]] charges. [https://www.dw.com/en/charlottesville-rally-unite-the-right-leaders-ordered-to-pay-26-million/a-59913676 (DW)] [https://www.cnn.com/2021/11/23/us/charlottesville-unite-the-right-trial-deliberations-tuesday/index.html (CNN)]
